name: Messaging, hourly
description: Every hour: mirrors this app into the messaging service (members, kinds of message, audiences; the platform's own messages made once) and feeds the digest and the app's own nudges with what they say (app\concepts\messaging\Runner::hourly). The service keeps the ledger and sends; a run that is repeated or interrupted never sends twice.

config.command: php -r 'require "vendor/autoload.php"; require \app\Paths::runtime() . "/bin/_boot.php"; new app\Bootstrap("conf/config.ini"); echo implode("\n", \app\concepts\messaging\Runner::hourly()) . "\n";'
